description: This file is an HTML document that provides the structure and styling for a web-based database visualization interface. It includes embedded CSS for styling and JavaScript for interactive functionalities such as fetching database data, toggling database and table views, and rendering data tables with expandable cell content.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the API and populates the sidebar with database items.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by re-invoking the loadDatabases function and resetting UI states.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables under a selected database and loads tables if expanding.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for the selected table within a database.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and inserts an HTML table with fetched data, adding features like wide content indication.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual cell contents, handling nulls, objects, and long text with expansion.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better readability, toggling between truncated and full content.
